decision_conditions: The proposed single storey rear extension would, by reason of its excessive depth and position close to the boundaries of the site, be an intrusive and unneighbourly development as well as having an adverse effect on the amenities of adjacent neighbours contrary to Policies 7 of the Havering Local Plan and the Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document.

Statement Required by Article 35 (2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015: Consideration was given to seeking amendments, but given conflict with adopted planning policy, notification of intended refusal and the reason(s) for it was given to Mr J Mazierski (Agent) by e-mail on 04/11/26.
description: Demolition of existing single storey rear extension, conservatory and front porch and construction of new single storey rear extension, new front porch and new windows fitted in existing front dormers.
